{{Top}}
'''Heat dispersion vents''' were part of a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Engine/Legends|engineering]] system. Alongside [[deflector plate]]s, they drew heat away from vital locations and discharged them into the vacuum of [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]].

When the second [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star]] was being designed, the flaw of the [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|thermal exhaust port]] was removed and replaced with a series of [[Millimeter/Legends|millimeter]]-wide heat dispersion ducts.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
